.ds-media { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-elevated, #faf4e7); }
.ds-media span { color: var(--color-signal, #a43620); opacity: 0.4; font: 600 3.75rem / 1 var(--font-display, Newsreader, ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif); letter-spacing: -0.05em; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio reads like a printed field report. Warm paper, serif headlines and thin rules organize the work. Project results keep their units and context close so readers can scan the numbers and understand what they measure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and coffee ink in light mode, warm charcoal and pale ink in dark mode.
Large Newsreader titles and figures with compact, readable sans-serif context.
Ruled sections, outlined diagrams and native disclosures.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve the brick or terracotta accent for evidence and interaction.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Keep the result, its units and its explanatory text in one reading group.

dos: Do Keep titles and measured results easy to locate at phone width.
Do Carry the warm paper and ink relationships through both themes.
Do Keep a visible keyboard focus treatment and 44px masthead and disclosure targets.
donts: Don't Add filled panels or shadows around the featured case rows.
Don't Turn technical details into a separate reading step when they can open in place.
